headline: Bespoke curtains and textile design for interiors
positioning: AFARA is a textile design and engineering studio for private homes, public interiors and professional project teams. We develop curtain compositions and manufacture to an individual design or to client drawings and dimensions. Based in Saint Petersburg, we work on projects worldwide.
partners: We collaborate with designers, architectural practices, developers and procurement teams. White label arrangements, client communication and confidentiality are agreed for each project.
logistics: Delivery, documentation and any work on site are agreed for the destination and order. No standard worldwide transit time is promised.
